# Board

**PPL language/runtime 4.00 - host object.**

[Object model and calling conventions](../objects.md) | [API index](index.md)

Read-only snapshot of board configuration and indexed conference and user collections.

[Behavior, constraints and examples](../../../new_ppl.md#board-and-session-400).

Use `Board` or `Board()` to obtain the current root object.

## AddUser

```PPL
Board.AddUser(STRING name) User
```

Instance function.

Creates a user with the `ADDUSER` defaults and returns its writable `USER` record. An empty or already used name fails with `ERR_INVALID` and returns an invalid `USER`.

## Conferences

`Board.Conferences: Conference[]`

Read-only instance property.

Read-only `CONFERENCE[]` snapshot of configured conferences.

## FindUser

```PPL
Board.FindUser(STRING name) User
```

Instance function.

Returns the writable `USER` record of the user with that name, or an invalid `USER` when nobody has that name. Writes are saved at once.

## Location

Read-only board identity, location, operator/sysop name, or configured node count.
